# TanyaDOSM

> TanyaDOSM answers plain-language questions using registered official Malaysian public datasets.

## Main page

- [Ask TanyaDOSM](/): Ask in English or Bahasa Melayu and review the official data source behind each answer.

## Usage notes

- Each question is answered independently from one registered dataset.
- Answers include the source agency, data date, unit, and verified rows used.
- TanyaDOSM does not produce forecasts or combine multiple datasets in one answer.
